Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Linden Classic Upholstered Dining Chair, 18.9"W, Set of 2, Cadet Blue
Colors: Cadet
This set of two classically styled armless dining chairs are upholstered in a cadet-blue fabric that makes them equally perfect for a classic dining room or eat-in kitchen. Their luxury and practicality means they evoke both romantic dinners for two and fabulous banquets for the whole family. 18.9"W x 24.4"D x 34.3"H; seat height: 19.3"H; seat depth: 18.5"D; seat back height: 19.7"H; leg height: 14.6"H Solid wood frame High back provides extra support and added flair. Simple dining chair boasts beautiful fabric. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
